brief: A storybook scene for a children's reading text, original characters. Evening by a campfire next to a wooden chalet at a forest lake in Québec. A kind grandfather with white hair and glasses sits by the fire telling a story with an expressive hand gesture; a grandmother sits beside him. Three children (8-10 years old, diverse) sit wrapped in plaid blankets, listening with wide curious eyes, holding mugs. Warm orange firelight, dark blue sky with a crescent moon, pine trees. Cozy and friendly. No text.

A storybook scene for a children's reading text, original characters. Long ago (around 1955): an old rustic log cabin camp for lumberjacks (camp de bûcherons) in a dense forest of tall pine trees near a lake, with an axe in a log and a stack of cut wood. A family with several young children stands in front of it. Daytime, soft pastel colours. No text, no modern objects.

A storybook scene for a children's reading text, original characters. Night. Seen from inside a small wooden bedroom: a 10-year-old boy in striped pyjamas stands at the window, hands on the glass, looking out in surprise. Behind him, his brothers and sisters are asleep in bunk beds. Through the window, far away, two adults in pyjamas run toward a moonlit lake. Calm, curious, not scary. Soft night blues with a little warm lamp light. No text.

A storybook scene for a children's reading text, original characters. Morning by a calm forest lake in Québec, morning mist on the water. A young mother and father from the 1950s talk seriously with a kind elderly Indigenous man (respectful, dignified, simple modern-for-the-1950s clothing, a plaid jacket, long grey braid), who points toward the lake as if telling a legend. A 10-year-old boy hides a little behind a tree, listening. Soft pastel morning colours. No text.

A storybook scene for a children's reading text, original characters. Night by a campfire near a lake. A red-haired girl (about 9, freckles) is wrapped tightly in a red plaid blanket up to her nose, gripping it with both hands, eyes glancing sideways toward the dark lake, a little worried. Beside her, a kind grandfather with white hair sips a mug of hot chocolate. Warm firelight, cozy, gently suspenseful but not scary. No text.

Children's storybook illustration, original characters. A snowy backyard after a snowstorm: a boy and a girl (about 8, diverse) in colourful snowsuits and mittens build a big snow fort behind a house, rosy cheeks, big smiles. Bright winter day, soft pastel colours. No text.

Children's storybook illustration, original characters. A girl (about 8) with a school backpack kneels gently near a park fence and discovers a small wet shivering puppy with no collar; she holds out her scarf to wrap it. Autumn afternoon, soft pastel colours, tender and kind. No text.

Children's storybook illustration, original characters. A Québec sugar shack (cabane à sucre) in spring: a class of children (diverse, about 8) with their teacher roll maple taffy on snow with wooden sticks; a friendly man in a plaid shirt stands near a steaming wooden shack with buckets on maple trees. Soft pastel colours. No text.

Children's storybook illustration, original characters. Inside a hockey arena: a young goalie (about 9) in full gear dives and catches the puck in his glove; teammates cheer, the crowd claps in the stands. Dynamic, joyful, soft pastel colours. No text, no team logos, no numbers.

Children's storybook illustration, original characters. A mixing bowl and flour on the counter. Gentle, sympathetic, soft pastel colours. No text.

Children's storybook illustration, original characters. Soft pastel colours. No text, no signs with words.

Children's storybook illustration, original characters. A suburban street: a moving truck in front of a house; a boy (about 8) carrying a soccer ball rings the doorbell of the house next door, and another boy (about 8) opens the door shyly, starting to smile. Sunny day, soft pastel colours. No text, no words on the truck.

Warm candlelight in a dark room, cozy. No text.

Children's storybook illustration, original characters. A neighbourhood library: a girl (about 8) and her younger brother hold up their winter drawings — hers shows a snowman with a red scarf, his shows a snowball fight; a librarian smiles behind a desk. Soft pastel colours. No text, no words on posters.

Children's storybook illustration, original characters. A summer day camp in a park: a boy (about 8) who looks shy at first is welcomed by a smiling young camp counselor with a whistle, while a group of diverse kids plays dodgeball in the background. Bright summer colours, soft pastel style. No text.
